functions.shared.caller_is_commissioner_for:
CREATE FUNCTION shared.caller_is_commissioner_for(p_team_key text) RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = ''
AS $fn$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM shared.app_role r
        JOIN auth.identities i ON i.provider = 'discord' AND i.provider_id = r.discord_user_id
        JOIN football.dim_fantasy_teams t ON t.team_key = p_team_key
        WHERE r.role = 'commissioner' AND r.league_key = 'main' AND i.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
$fn$;
functions.shared.caller_is_site_admin:
CREATE FUNCTION shared.caller_is_site_admin() RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = ''
AS $fn$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM shared.app_role r
        JOIN auth.identities i ON i.provider = 'discord' AND i.provider_id = r.discord_user_id
        WHERE r.role = 'site_admin' AND r.league_key = '*' AND i.user_id = auth.uid()
    )
$fn$;
functions.shared.caller_team_keys:
CREATE FUNCTION shared.caller_team_keys() RETURNS SETOF text
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = ''
AS $fn$
    SELECT c.team_key
    FROM shared.owner_crosswalk c
    JOIN auth.identities i ON i.provider = 'discord' AND i.provider_id = c.discord_user_id
    WHERE i.user_id = auth.uid()
$fn$;
functions.shared.choice_window:
CREATE FUNCTION shared.choice_window(p_season_id text, p_choice_kind text) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = ''
AS $fn$
    SELECT coalesce(
        (SELECT CASE WHEN d.final_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN 'final'
                     WHEN d.deadline_at > clock_timestamp() THEN 'open'
                     ELSE 'passed' END
         FROM ops.choice_deadline d
         WHERE d.season_id = p_season_id AND d.choice_kind = p_choice_kind),
        'none')
$fn$;
functions.shared.pii_token_hashes:
CREATE FUNCTION shared.pii_token_hashes() RETURNS SETOF text
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = ''
AS $fn$
    SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(s.token, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
    FROM (
        SELECT regexp_split_to_table(lower(o.human_name), '[[:space:]]+') AS token FROM shared.owner o
        UNION
        SELECT lower(o.fantrax_username) FROM shared.owner o
        UNION
        SELECT c.discord_user_id FROM shared.owner_crosswalk c
        UNION
        SELECT r.discord_user_id FROM shared.app_role r
    ) s
    WHERE s.token IS NOT NULL AND s.token <> ''
$fn$;
